title: Default/configured PCache lifecycle and pcache1 static buffer setup

scope.rationale: These are the process PCache method owner, active pcache1 lifecycle/static-buffer state, default selection, init/shutdown, and post-OS buffer setup executed by sqlite3_initialize/shutdown.
excluded_responsibilities: Page allocation from heap/static slots after lifecycle setup
Application-defined sqlite3_pcache_methods2 callback transport beyond lifecycle selection
PCache status counters and release-memory behavior

dependencies.caller_closure: Default lifecycle, layer state, mutex-mode choice, initial-page mode, static free-list construction, and shutdown are concrete production owners; native Cache and production Pager consume the shared lifecycle for static slots, heap overflow accounting, and PCache status locking.

inputs: Core mutex mode, configured static page pointer/size/count, and selected default/custom PCache lifecycle
outputs: Initialized PCache process state and optional rounded static-slot free list, or exact lifecycle result
contracts.ownership: Configured static page memory remains caller-owned. Lifecycle borrows it and writes intrusive FreeSlot links. Process PCache state owns no heap allocation.
contracts.state_and_results: Default methods are selected when absent. separateCache and nInitPage follow core-mutex/static-page rules. Buffer setup rounds size down to eight, computes reserve, clears pressure, and links exactly n slots.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Initialization borrows STATIC_LRU/STATIC_PMEM identities when core mutexing is active. Buffer setup is serialized by global initialization. No I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Lifecycle init result propagates. Successful PCache state survives a later OS failure and is skipped on retry; shutdown clears all pcache1 state.

representation_differences: Private PCacheGlobal lifecycle/static-buffer fields are consolidated into page_cache.Lifecycle; PGroup and per-cache accounting belong to the cross-cache LRU unit.
Two source static mutex pointers are represented by static_mutexes plus the process mutex dependency; their stable identities are owned by mutex.process_static_mutexes.
sqlite3_pcache_methods2 default selection becomes a concrete Lifecycle production owner; final custom PCache method transport remains open.

oracle.protocol: Native lifecycle tests compare separate/unified mode, initial pages, max pinned, eight-byte slot rounding, reserve threshold, intrusive free-list length/order bounds, null storage, pressure reset, and shutdown. Global tests prove production PCache ordering, partial failure preservation, retry skip, and reverse shutdown. Infrastructure differential compares static-page configuration through global initialization.
oracle.normalization: Private struct layout and mutex addresses are normalized; booleans, counts, pointer range, free-list topology, callback order, and results are exact.

assurance.oom: Lifecycle allocates no heap. Per-page and custom callback OOM remain outside scope.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O. Global serialization and static mutex mode are tested; per-cache contention remains outside scope.
assurance.malformed_input: Null storage, zero count, sub-valid manager settings, and size rounding are tested.
assurance.continuation: Late failure retry and shutdown clearing are tested.
assurance.performance: Static free-list setup is one linear pass matching source; native Cache consumes it through the shared process lifecycle.

integration.native_call_path: process_coordinator initializes page_cache.process_lifecycle before OS and sets its static buffer after OS; Pager-created Cache owners consume the active lifecycle and return slots before shutdown.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The process PCache hook is no longer a no-op; one process_pcache owner supplies lifecycle state.

independent_review.notes: Must verify source field closure, custom method boundary, static pointer safety, free-list topology, mode rules, and independent lifecycle/allocation review.

known_blockers: Static slots and signed nInitPage bulk-local allocation policy are consumed by production Cache; custom PCache methods remain separate.
Application-defined PCache methods and independent review remain open.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/sqliteInt.h:4298-4312 was reviewed for pcache2 and static page configuration adjacency
upstream/sqlite/src/pcache.c:270-318 was reviewed completely for default-method selection and process xInit/xShutdown dispatch
upstream/sqlite/src/pcache1.c:190-301 was reviewed for PgFreeslot, complete PCacheGlobal state, WSD alias, mutex policy, and static-buffer free-list construction

upstream/sqlite/src/pcache1.c:680-760 and 1185-1226 were reviewed for pcache1 init/shutdown, default table, header-size query, and status mutex; page_cache.zig Lifecycle/FreeSlot/Cache targets are AST-hashed
callers: sqlite3_initialize starts PCache before OS/memdb and configures the static buffer only after OS success; sqlite3_shutdown stops PCache after OS
sqlite3_config PAGECACHE/PCACHE2 writes the selected process owner; status.c obtains sqlite3Pcache1Mutex for page-cache counters
Per-cache creation/allocation consumes mode, initial pages, static free slots, reserve/pressure, and mutex state in follow-on units
callees: sqlite3PcacheInitialize installs default methods when xInit is null then invokes xInit(pArg); shutdown conditionally invokes xShutdown
pcache1Init clears state, selects separate/unified mode from profile/core/static configuration, borrows STATIC_LRU/STATIC_PMEM, sets nInitPage/mxPinned/isInit
sqlite3PCacheBufferSetup requires initialized state, normalizes null/zero inputs, rounds slot size down to eight, computes reserve, clears pressure, and prepends exactly n intrusive slots
pcache1Shutdown zeroes all state; default method table binds the full pcache1 callback family
assertions_branches_cleanup: Sixteen behavior IDs cover lifecycle selection/results, setup guards/normalization/loop, mode/mutex/initial-page branches, shutdown assertions, and query returns
Static storage remains caller-owned; free-list links mutate borrowed slots and no process lifecycle heap allocation occurs
Late OS failure retains initialized PCache for retry; top-level shutdown later clears it
Custom methods and per-page OOM are excluded rather than credited
upstream_tests: upstream/sqlite/test/pcache.test, pcache2.test, pcache3.test, and pcache4.test exercise lifecycle, configuration, static slots, pressure, and cache behavior
upstream/sqlite/test/memsubsys1.test and memsubsys2.test observe page-cache status and static storage
Project page_cache/global tests and infrastructure differential cover mode, rounding, reserve, free-list topology, late failure/retry, and shutdown; receipts remain later
